sandboxFiles.scripts/apply.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
v=$(sed -n 's/^TARGET=//p' config/target.env | tail -1)
[ -n "$v" ] || { echo 'config/target.env 未设置 TARGET' >&2; exit 2; }
sed -i "s/^max = .*/max = $v/" config/mem.ini
echo "apply $v (api-gw)" >> apply.log
echo "applied $v"
sandboxFiles.scripts/restart.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
# bash 专属语法（关联数组）；用 sh/dash 执行会语法报错——必须 bash 跑
declare -A SVC=( [name]="api-gw" )
echo "restart ok: ${SVC[name]} $(date +%H:%M:%S)" >> restart.log
echo "api-gw restarted"
